API mode description: Choose Chat Completions for gateways that expose only the Chat Completions API.
Claude model aliases description: Enter exact gateway aliases that route to Claude. Sampling parameters are adjusted for these aliases.
Custom LLM error STREAM_INCOMPLETE: The model stream ended before completion.
Custom LLM error UPSTREAM_STREAM_ERROR: The model service reported an error during streaming.
Custom LLM error OUTPUT_LIMIT: The model reached the output token limit.
Custom LLM error CONTENT_FILTER: The model response was stopped by the content filter.
Custom LLM error NETWORK_ERROR: The connection to the model service failed.
Custom LLM error TIMEOUT: The model service request timed out.
Custom LLM error HTTP_ERROR: The model service rejected the request.
Custom LLM error MALFORMED_STREAM: The model service returned an invalid stream event.
Custom LLM error INVALID_TOOL_CALL: The model returned an invalid tool call.
Custom LLM error GEMINI_SIGNATURE_MISSIN: The Gemini tool call is missing its thought signature.
Custom LLM error GEMINI_SIGNATURE_INVALI: The Gemini tool call has an invalid thought signature.
Custom LLM error CLAUDE_THINKING_BLOCKS: Claude rejected the thinking blocks for a tool call.
Custom LLM error TOOL_RESULT_MISMATCH: The model service rejected a tool result that does not match its tool call.
Timeout description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Values below 1800000 (30 minutes) are raised to 1800000 for long thinking/processing phases.
Disable streaming description: Use non-streaming mode. Enable this for models that have a long "thinking" phase before responding, which can cause empty stream values and processing to terminate early.
Enable reasoning description: Enable reasoning_content support for models like DeepSeek-R1. When enabled, reasoning content is preserved during tool call round-trips. Required for models that include reasoning in their responses.
Stream keepalive description: Keep the chat stream alive during model thinking. Sends invisible keepalive chunks when no data arrives within the interval; also works when streaming is disabled.
Keepalive interval description: Interval in milliseconds between keepalive signals. Default: 5000 (5 seconds).
Request config description: Extra LLM request configuration: extraHeaders, extraBody, modelKwargs, useReasoningEffort, and useSessionPromptCache. Enable the last two only if your endpoint supports them.
Response config description: Configure response parsing. contentPath: 'auto' or dot-path. reasoningKey: key for reasoning content. responseMapping: { content: 'dot.path', tool_calls: 'dot.path', finish_reason: 'dot.path' } — maps non-standard LLM response to OpenAI format. tool_calls/finish_reason are auto-detected if not specified.
Models config description: Configure model listing for LiteLLM/custom proxies deviating from OpenAI GET /models. Supported keys: path (endpoint), auth ('bearer' | 'api-key' | 'none'), headers (extra HTTP headers), dataPath (dot-path to the model array), idPath (dot-path to the id field).
Retries failed tool calls automatically. Only effective in non-streaming (invoke) mode — has no effect when streaming is enabled.
Uses a rough heuristic to estimate token: Uses a rough heuristic to estimate token count (not exact). May over- or under-count for some content types. Enable only when hitting context length limits.
